newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azeris name Deminex, Agip in oil deal - agencies.
newsitem.headline: Azeris name Deminex, Agip in oil deal - agencies.

text.p: Azeri President Haydar Aliyev said on Wednesday Azerbaijan would divide a 25 percent stake in the Lenkoran-Talysh Deniz oil development project between three foreign firms, Azeri news agencies reported Wednesday.

Aliyev, quoted in the Turkmenistan capital Ashgabat, said he planned to sell 10 percent of the $2 billion project to Germany's Veba AG unit Deminex, five percent to Italy's Agip and 10 percent to an unnamed Iranian oil company.

Daud Babayev, deputy head of the foreign investment section of Azerbaijan's state oil company SOCAR, told Reuters that "at the moment nothing has been written up legally, but SOCAR is working on the problem."
The project to develop fields in Azerbaijan's section of the Caspian Sea was signed in January.
France's Elf Aquitaine has a 40 percent share, rival French company Total 10 percent and SOCAR 25 percent, in addition to the stake left to be divided.
